tldr: Morning batch (Sep 9): OpenAI claims an AI-generated, Lean-verified solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize problem — immediately mired in a scooping scandal, with NYU's Tristan Buckmaster alleging OpenAI pressured him to drop an Anthropic co-author. Meta launches Muse, its personal AI agent for everyone (Secure VM + Sentinel approval agent, $20/$100 tiers), a day after scrapping 'tokenmaxxing' from engineer reviews. OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.5 with two new API image models (Flare, Sunburst) and fully rolls out the Astra agent to all paid tiers. Hermes Agent lands first-class inside DHH's Omarchy Linux distro. Moonshot's Kimi K3 2.8T runs at ~1 token/s on a MacBook from SSDs; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash enters internal API beta; inclusionAI's Ling-3.0-flash-VL brings 124B MoE image/video understanding.

articles.title: OpenAI claims AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem — scooping row erupts
articles.summary: Unreleased model 'stronger than GPT-6 Astra' produced a 3D Navier–Stokes blow-up proof, Lean-verified by ~10K agents over 88 hrs — but NYU's Buckmaster alleges his team was scooped and pressured.

articles.title: Meta launches Muse, its personal AI agent for everyone
articles.summary: Zuck's consumer 'personal superintelligence' agent runs in a Secure VM gated by a Sentinel approval agent. Free tier, Power $20/mo, Maximum $100/mo. Reuters found internal tests stalling.

articles.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is GA — with two new API image models
articles.summary: Rolling out to all ChatGPT, Work and Codex users. API adds GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (speed + editing) and Sunburst (precision, slower, longer generations).

articles.title: OpenAI's Astra agent reaches full GA across all paid tiers
articles.summary: Astra is fully rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users in Codex and ChatGPT Work — OpenAI's autonomous agent is now generally available.

articles.title: Meta drops AI usage from engineer reviews after 'tokenmaxxing' backfires
articles.summary: A year of grading 'AI-driven impact' became a token-burning race (+220% code changes YoY, only +36% reaching users). Execs now grade shipped quality, not AI consumption.

articles.title: Hermes Agent gets first-class support in DHH's Omarchy Linux
articles.summary: Install Hermes from Omarchy's AI menu or set it as your default terminal agent — Omarchy's theme flows into the desktop app, TUI and CLI. Teknium: 'available built in to Omarchy now!'

articles.title: Kimi K3 (2.8T MoE) runs at ~1 token/s on a MacBook Pro, streamed from four SSDs
articles.summary: Deltafin fork sustains 1.0 tok/s decode of Moonshot's open-weight K3 on an M5 Max by SSD-streaming experts with a Qwen drafter. Frontier MoEs keep creeping onto consumer hardware.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash enters internal API beta
articles.summary: Chinese beta notice: intermediate V4.1 Flash adopts native multimodal architecture with stronger capability, faster speed and lower cost — base_url unchanged.

articles.title: inclusionAI Ling-3.0-flash-VL: 124B MoE with native image/video understanding
articles.summary: Ling-3.0-flash-VL extends the flash line with vision: 124B total params, only 5.5B active per token, context window up to 1M tokens.

articles.title: GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments via Codex
articles.summary: OpenAI shows GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex autonomously running and analyzing quantum computing experiments end-to-end — agentic research loop in practice.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Code lead publicly names labs on prompt-injection risk
articles.summary: bcherny says OpenAI's new model is now on par with Gemini Flash and Opus 4.8 on injection risk; claims Claude solved prompt injection in practice ~2 months ago. Will keep naming labs.
